subject: downloadHandler doesn't work as expected from within a tabPanel()

messages.author: 207205de2f4712d1
messages.subject: downloadHandler doesn't work as expected from within a tabPanel()
parts:
I was experimenting with the tutorial example using downloadHandler. The functionality behaves as expected when contained within the mainPanel and sidebarPanel, but when I put the dropdown and download button in a tabPanel (within a tabsetPanel), clicking the "Download" button simply opens another window tab and loads the application (rather than simply downloading the data).  I will work with this more tonight, but I thought I'd share if there is a quick reason that I simply don't yet understand as to why this would happen. Any ideas?

If I don't figure it out later, I will post sample code to get to the bottom of this.

Thank you.

PS I did learn that for the download button to work properly, the entire page must first load. Not allowing the page to load will result in the same unexpected behavior as I mention in the body of my message here... maybe the behavior is related(?).

parts:
Hi Joe. I have the following code in server.R: shinyServer(function(input, output) { <here> } )

  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(

    filename = function() { paste(input$dataset, '.csv', sep = '') },

    content = function(file) {

      write.csv(datasetInput(), file)

    }

  )

  outputOptions(output, 'downloadData', suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)


... and, in ui.R: shinyUI(pageWithSidebar( headerPanel(), mainPanel( tabsetPanel( <here> ) ), sidebarPanel() ))

      tabPanel('Data',

        selectInput('dataset', 'Data: (you know you want it)', choices = c("Today's Log")),

        downloadButton('downloadData', 'Download')

      )

ANNNND... it worked! May I ask what the issue was here; and is this something that is already understood by the shiny community? ... I just want to know in case I experience a similar issue down the road, with my development, or in other contexts unrelated to user downloads.

Thanks a bunch!
